h1: The 7 Best Portable Spot Cleaners for Pet Accidents and Hair in 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Spot Cleaners for Pets: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 portable spot cleaners for pet urine, vomit and hair from BISSELL, Shark, Rug Doctor and Hoover, compared on tools and value.
summary: The BISSELL Little Green Max Pet is the strongest dedicated pet spot cleaner here and the one to buy for repeat accidents. The Pet Pro adds a more advanced pet-oriented design, the Rug Doctor Pet chases embedded stains with suction, and the Hoover CleanSlate Plus is the budget pick that still does solid work.
intro: The stain you see on the carpet after a pet accident is the smaller problem. The real trouble is what sank below it: urine travels through fibres into the backing and pad, and if a machine only skims the surface, the smell returns on the first humid day and your pet is drawn back to the same spot. For a pet, the question is not does it clean, but does it reach the pad and pull the liquid back out.

That is why this ranking weights extraction, pet-specific tools for hair and odour, and how easy the machine is to run at 2 a.m. after a surprise. We sorted seven portable models using their listings and feature lists, not trials, and we say plainly when a listing gives no figure.

products.name: BISSELL Little Green Max Pet Portable Carpet Cleaner, 3860
products.verdict: The strongest dedicated pet pickup in this ranking, from the best-known spot-cleaner family.
products.description:
The Max Pet is the top of BISSELL's pet line within the Little Green range and carries the strongest dedicated pet pickup claim in this ranking. It is a compact machine with a hose and handheld tool, sold for $100 to $200.

First place follows from one simple fact: for pets, pickup is everything. A cleaner that pulls more liquid out of the fibres leaves less for odour to grow in, and the Max Pet is built around that goal. The compromise is that it is more machine than a household with a rare accident needs.

Buy it if your pet has repeat accidents or a medical issue that creates them. Skip it if your pet is an adult cat that has never had a problem.
pros: Compact, easy to bring out fast
cons: More machine than rare accidents need
Same tier as other pet models
products.skipIf: Your pet rarely makes a mess.

products.name: BISSELL Little Green Pet Pro Portable Carpet Cleaner, 3909
products.verdict: BISSELL's more advanced pet-oriented design, close behind the Max Pet.
products.description:
The Pet Pro is positioned as BISSELL's more advanced pet-oriented model, in the $100 to $200 tier. It is aimed at owners who want to compare several pet-focused variants and pick the one with the right attachments.

Second place means it is a near-tie with the Max Pet. We rank the Max Pet above it for pickup, while the Pet Pro is the choice if you value the more developed pet design and tooling. Both do the same job of extracting liquid from carpet and furniture.

Buy it if you want a pet-specific machine and prefer the broader tool story. Skip it if you want the highest pickup claim.
pros: Pet tooling for hair and stains
cons: Pickup claim is below Max Pet

products.name: Rug Doctor Pet Portable Spot Cleaner
products.verdict: A suction-led machine with a dual-action pet tool that lifts hair as it cleans.
products.description:
The Rug Doctor Pet is sold on the most powerful suction in its range and includes a dual-action pet tool that picks up hair, removes stains and tackles odours. It rolls on wheels and has a retractable handle.

Third place reflects a tradeoff. Suction is excellent for embedded stains, and a wheeled body is easier to move between rooms than a handheld-sized unit. But the listing offers fewer clear specs, and no price bracket is given, so confirm before buying.

Buy it if embedded stains are your problem and you like a wheeled machine. Skip it if you want a documented price and size.
products.skipIf: You need a clear price picture.

products.name: BISSELL Little Green Pet Deluxe Portable Carpet Cleaner, 3353
products.verdict: A pet-focused Little Green that sits just behind the newer Max Pet and Pet Pro.
products.description:
The Pet Deluxe 3353 is another pet-focused Little Green, at $100 to $200. It is for owners comparing several Little Green pet variants.

It lands fourth since the two newer BISSELL pet machines above it were built later and are described with stronger pickup or a more advanced design. The Deluxe still does the core job of lifting pet stains from carpet and upholstery. If you find it on a good deal, it is a sensible choice.

Buy it if it is available at a lower price than the Max Pet. Skip it if you want the strongest design.
products.idealFor: Pet owners hunting for a deal on a Little Green.

products.name: Shark StainStriker Portable Carpet/Upholstery Cleaner, 4 Tools, PX202BRN
products.verdict: Four included tools give the most attachments of any machine here.
products.description:
The Shark StainStriker PX202BRN ships with four tools and is the machine to choose for the most attachments. It costs $100 to $200.

It is fifth because it is a general-purpose cleaner, not a pet-specific one, and pet households benefit most from pickup and a hair-lifting tool. The four tools help with stairs, car seats and sofas where pets sleep.

Buy it if your pet leaves hair and stains in many places. Skip it if you want a pet-specific tool.
products.idealFor: Pets sleeping on furniture, stairs and cars.

products.name: Shark StainStriker Portable Spot and Stain Cleaner, 2 Tools, PX221BRN
products.verdict: A two-tool StainStriker that the listing positions for cordless freedom on spot treatment.
products.description:
The PX221BRN is a two-tool StainStriker that the listing frames for cordless-style freedom on spot jobs. It costs $100 to $200.

It is sixth because cordless machines usually give up run time and tank size for convenience. For a quick accident, though, being able to grab it and go without finding an outlet is a real advantage, especially at night. Check battery details on the listing before buying.

Buy it if you want to treat spots fast without a cord. Skip it if you expect long cleaning sessions.
products.idealFor: Fast spot treatment of fresh accidents.

products.name: Hoover CleanSlate Plus Portable Carpet + Upholstery Spot Cleaner Machine
products.verdict: A budget-friendly option that still delivers solid performance for pet owners.
products.description:
Hoover's CleanSlate Plus handles carpet and upholstery jobs for $50 to $100, which suits budget-conscious pet owners who still want solid performance.

Seventh place is because it is not pet-specific and gives you no dedicated pet tool. As a first machine for a household with an occasional pet accident, it does the job at a lower price.

Buy it if you want a capable machine for less. Skip it if accidents are frequent.
products.idealFor: Occasional pet accidents on a budget.

whatMatters.detail: Pet urine soaks through carpet to the pad, so a machine that extracts well matters more than one that scrubs hard. Look for suction or pickup claims and a tool that lets you press and pull slowly. Several slow passes with clean water beat one wet pass.
Pet formulas aim to break down the compounds that cause smell, not just mask them. Using a pet formula in a spot cleaner is better than plain stain remover. Confirm the maker sells one for the model.
Pet hair traps in the nap and clogs brushes. A dual-action tool or rubber head helps lift hair and scrub together. Check whether the tool is in the box.
Accidents are urgent, and fresh stains clean far more easily than dried ones. A machine you can grab and fill in a minute gets used. Keep it somewhere you can reach it quickly.
Dirty-water tanks from pet cleaning smell fast. Empty and rinse them after each use and leave them to dry. A wide-mouth tank makes this easier.

faq.q: Will a spot cleaner remove pet urine smell?
faq.a: It helps a lot, especially with a pet formula and strong extraction. Old, deep stains may need repeat treatments or professional help, and some may need subfloor treatment.
Scrubbing before blotting. Blot up the liquid first, then use the machine to extract, and avoid steam on urine because heat can set odours.

faq.q: Is the Max Pet worth it over the Hoover?
faq.a: For frequent accidents, yes, because of stronger pickup and pet-focused design. For rare accidents, the Hoover is enough.
Fill the clean tank with water and formula, attach the hose and tool, plug in, and begin. It takes about two minutes.

faq.q: How do I stop the machine smelling?
faq.a: Empty and rinse both tanks and the hose after each use, and leave the lids off to dry.

faq.q: Is it safe for pets and kids?
faq.a: Use the maker's formula as directed, rinse with clean water and let the area dry before pets return. Check the product label for safety guidance.

finalTake: For pet households, the BISSELL Little Green Max Pet is the best portable spot cleaner here because it focuses on pickup, which is what stops odours returning. The Pet Pro is the close alternative, and the Rug Doctor Pet is the suction-first pick for embedded stains. If budget is tight, the Hoover CleanSlate Plus is a capable starter. Act quickly on every accident and finish with clean-water rinsing.
